name: LoveSpark History Cleaner
summary: One-click browsing history cleanup. Choose last hour, day, or week. Privacy-first, free, no data sent anywhere.
detailed_description:
Clean your browsing history with one click. No digging through settings.

Sometimes you just want to clear your recent browsing history without navigating through Chrome's buried settings menus. Maybe you're on a shared computer, maybe you value privacy, or maybe your ADHD brain hyperfocused on something embarrassing and you'd rather forget about it. LoveSpark History Cleaner puts a one-click cleanup button right in your toolbar.

FEATURES

- One-click history cleanup from your toolbar
- Three time range options: last hour, last day, last week
- Uses Chrome's browsingData API for thorough, reliable cleanup
- Confirmation before clearing to prevent accidental deletion
- Track how many cleanups you've done today and total
- Clean, simple interface — no confusing options or settings
- No browsing data is read or displayed — only deleted when you ask
- 4 cozy themes: Retro Pink, Dark Noir, Warm Beige, Cool Slate
- Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support

HOW IT WORKS

1. Click the History Cleaner icon in your toolbar
2. Choose your time range: last hour, last day, or last week
3. Confirm the cleanup
4. Done — your selected browsing history is cleared

WHY LOVESPARK

LoveSpark is built by a neurodivergent developer who believes privacy should be one click away, not buried in settings. History Cleaner doesn't monitor your browsing, doesn't read your history, and doesn't store anything about what you've visited. It's just a clean button for when you want one.

Every LoveSpark extension is free, open source, and privacy-first. We believe privacy tools should be simple enough that everyone uses them.

PRIVACY FIRST

LoveSpark History Cleaner stores all data locally in your browser. We collect zero data. No analytics. No tracking. No ads. No account required. Your data never leaves your device. The browsingData and history permissions are used exclusively to clear your browsing history when you click the button — the extension never reads or stores your browsing activity.

OPEN SOURCE

This extension is open source under the MIT license. View the code at github.com/Joona-t/lovespark-history-cleaner.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — free retro pink tools for neurodivergent minds.
